messages:
jordan (support): Customer NovaAI (acct: nova_east) just opened a ticket asking for a 48h temporary burst to ~30M tokens/day for an end-of-quarter demo. They say traffic spike is scheduled tomorrow. Billing shows promo credits and a payment method mismatch flagged by payments team. Can we do a conditional uplift while fraud/security review runs?

fraud-bot: Automated scan result: payment_method_mismatch + multiple source IPs in last 24h. Risk score: 72. Holding any automatic quota increases until manual review completed.

tara (sales): This is a strategic deal — they told us we'll lose the pilot if we can't support the demo. Sales is asking for a conditional uplift with strict guards. We can get SOW signed within 24h if product/eng agree.

maya (eng-sre): We can implement a temporary per-customer conditional policy (hard caps + telemetry) rather quickly. Proposal sketch: per-route token cap, per-minute aggregate cap, and auto-revoke on error spike. Need product to confirm acceptance criteria and security to clear manual fraud check.

rohan (product): OK — product asks for explicit launch criteria before we allow any burst: 1) manual fraud clearance, 2) perf canary shows p95 < 200ms on sample demo traffic, 3) cost impact estimate < 3x baseline for 48h or explicit sales approval. I'll create backlog item "conditional burst policy for strategic customers" and scope the minimal guardrails. Marking priority P2.

eli (security): We cannot bypass fraud checks. Minimal requirements to lift: (a) billing owner verification (call + docs), (b) signed SOW or PO, (c) temporary per-minute and per-second caps, (d) audit logging enabled for all requests in the window. If any anomaly, revoke immediately.

jordan (support): Customer has uploaded a draft SOW and provided two billing contacts. Link: https://drive.redwood/novaai/sow (they marked as urgent). Should I hold until legal confirms or can we do conditional unlocked access?

maya (eng-sre): Draft config I'm proposing (for eng implementation):
```json
{"policy":"conditional_burst","customer":"nova_east","duration_hours":48,"token_cap_total":30000000,"per_minute_cap":500000,"concurrent_request_limit":50,"fallback_model":"small-quantized","hooks":{"fraud_check":"manual_ok","rollback_on_error_rate":0.01}}
```
This enforces a hard total cap and per-minute throttle, plus a fallback model to control cost.

rohan (product): Add acceptance criteria to the backlog item: (a) manual fraud ok recorded in ticket, (b) canary ingress at 10% of requested load for 30 minutes with no errors, (c) alerts wired to oncall and product slack channel, (d) documented rollback runbook. If all pass, escalate to eng-oncall for temporary rollout. Estimate 3 dev-days for a safe path.

tara (sales): If we can do the conditional uplift now we will finalize the annual contract. Can product/eng expedite? :pray:

maya (eng-sre): Tagging eng-oncall @alex to actually implement the guardrails and canary. Alex — can you pick this up? React with :eyes: if you can run it today.

alex (eng-oncall): On it. I'll spin up a canary config, set token caps, and add Prometheus alerts for error rate and token burn. ETA: 4 hours for canary, 8 hours for full temporary rollout (assuming manual fraud ok).

fraud-bot: Manual review requested by eli (security). Review notes and mitigation checklist saved at https://intra.redwood/security/reviews/NOVA-1853456789. Next steps: security verification + billing call.

jordan (support): Thanks everyone — moving this to handoff. Support will mark the customer as "pending-conditional-uplift" and hold until fraud and billing verification complete. I'll update the ticket once uplift is live. :white_check_mark:
